adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx`, the remove icon tooltip is hardcoded as `content="Remove email"` rather than using `t(...)`, while other user-facing strings in the component/dialog use localization (e.g. `t("add_another")`, `label` from `t("add_emails")`). This creates an inconsistent, untranslated UI string for non-English locales, but it does not break functionality.
